title: `[http.client.proxy]` is the only way an outbound call is proxied: `System` class, written by the operator, and never a call option or an environment variable
divergesFromPhp: curl and PHP's stream wrappers take a proxy from `HTTP_PROXY`/`HTTPS_PROXY` in the environment, or per handle from `CURLOPT_PROXY`; here it is one root-owned block, no environment variable is read, and no program-side spelling exists
